mapper.select: SELECT REPORTTYPE AS reportType, PROPERTYCODE AS propertyCode, BALANCE AS balance FROM CHB_MONTH_REPORT_DETAIL DETAIL WHERE DETAIL.REPORTUUID = (SELECT REPORTUUID FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY T.TERMID ORDER BY T.UPDATE_TIME DESC) RN, T.REPORTUUID, T.TERMID FROM CHB_MONTH_REPORT T ) WHERE RN = 1 AND TERMID = #{termId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

SELECT NVL(SUM(CMAP.ASSETVALUE_A), 0) AS balance FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION CMAP LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT ON FP.FINPROD_ID = FPT.FINPROD_ID WHERE TO_CHAR(CMAP.ENDDATE, 'yyyyMM') = #{termId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND FPT.TYPE_11 = '057'

WITH OTHER_TABLE AS (
SELECT CMAP.ASSETVALUE_A AS ASSETVALUE_A, INFO.INDUSTRY AS INDUSTRY, CMAP.STARTDATE AS STARTDATE FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION CMAP LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO INFO ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = INFO.ASSET_CODE WHERE CMAP.STARTDATE IN (#{startDate, jdbcType = DATE}, #{lastStartDate, jdbcType = DATE}) AND INFO.ASSET_TYPE2 = '2101' AND INFO.INDUSTRY IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT CMAP.ASSETVALUE_A AS ASSETVALUE_A, INFO.INDUSTRY1 AS INDUSTRY, CMAP.STARTDATE AS STARTDATE FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION CMAP LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO INFO ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = INFO.ASSET_CODE WHERE CMAP.STARTDATE IN (#{startDate, jdbcType = DATE}, #{lastStartDate, jdbcType = DATE}) AND INFO.ASSET_TYPE2 IN ('2201', '2299') AND INFO.INDUSTRY1 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL
SELECT CMAP.ASSETVALUE_A AS ASSETVALUE_A, INFO.INDUSTRY_SHARES AS INDUSTRY, CMAP.STARTDATE AS STARTDATE FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION CMAP LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO INFO ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = INFO.ASSET_CODE WHERE CMAP.STARTDATE IN (#{startDate, jdbcType = DATE}, #{lastStartDate, jdbcType = DATE}) AND INFO.ASSET_TYPE = '06' AND INFO.INDUSTRY_SHARES IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT CMAP.ASSETVALUE_A AS ASSETVALUE_A, INFO.INDUSTRY1 AS INDUSTRY, CMAP.STARTDATE AS STARTDATE FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION CMAP LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO INFO ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = INFO.ASSET_CODE LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT ON FPT.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID WHERE CMAP.STARTDATE IN (#{startDate, jdbcType = DATE}, #{lastStartDate, jdbcType = DATE}) AND FPT.TYPE_11 IN ('057', '075', '076') AND INFO.INDUSTRY1 IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT CMAP.ASSETVALUE_A AS ASSETVALUE_A, INFO.CAP_USE_INDU AS INDUSTRY, CMAP.STARTDATE AS STARTDATE FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION CMAP LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO INFO ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = INFO.ASSET_CODE WHERE CMAP.STARTDATE IN (#{startDate, jdbcType = DATE}, #{lastStartDate, jdbcType = DATE}) AND INFO.ASSET_TYPE = '16' AND INFO.CAP_USE_INDU IS NOT NULL ) /*债券本季末数额*/ SELECT 'BONDCUR' AS reportType, INFO.INDUSTRY AS propertyCode, NVL(SUM(NVL(CMAP.ASSETVALUE_A, 0)), 0) AS balance FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION CMAP LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO INFO ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = INFO.ASSET_CODE WHERE CMAP.STARTDATE = #{startDate, jdbcType = DATE} AND INFO.INDUSTRY IS NOT NULL AND INFO.ASSET_TYPE2 IN ('1102', '1111', '1112', '1113', '1114', '1115', '1116') GROUP BY INFO.INDUSTRY /*债券上季末数额*/ UNION ALL SELECT 'BONDLAST' AS reportType, INFO.INDUSTRY AS propertyCode, NVL(SUM(NVL(CMAP.ASSETVALUE_A, 0)), 0) AS balance FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION CMAP LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO INFO ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = INFO.ASSET_CODE WHERE CMAP.STARTDATE = #{lastStartDate, jdbcType = DATE} AND INFO.INDUSTRY IS NOT NULL AND INFO.ASSET_TYPE2 IN ('1102', '1111', '1112', '1113', '1114', '1115', '1116') GROUP BY INFO.INDUSTRY /*非标准化债权类投资本季末数额*/ UNION ALL SELECT 'NOSTABONDCUR' AS reportType, NVL(INFO.INDUSTRY1, INFO.INDUSTRY_SHARES) AS propertyCode, NVL(SUM(NVL(CMAP.ASSETVALUE_A, 0)), 0) AS balance FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION CMAP LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO INFO ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = INFO.ASSET_CODE LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT ON FPT.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID WHERE CMAP.STARTDATE = #{startDate, jdbcType = DATE}
AND INFO.ASSET_TYPE IN ('04', '05', '14') AND INFO.ASSET_TYPE2 NOT IN ('2101', '1399', '1599', '2299')
AND FPT.TYPE_11 NOT IN ('057', '075', '076') AND (INFO.INDUSTRY1 IS NOT NULL OR INFO.INDUSTRY_SHARES IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY NVL(INFO.INDUSTRY1, INFO.INDUSTRY_SHARES) /*非标准化债权类投资上季末数额*/ UNION ALL SELECT 'NOSTABONDLAST' AS reportType, NVL(INFO.INDUSTRY1, INFO.INDUSTRY_SHARES) AS propertyCode, NVL(SUM(NVL(CMAP.ASSETVALUE_A, 0)), 0) AS balance FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION CMAP LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO INFO ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = INFO.ASSET_CODE LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT ON FPT.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID WHERE CMAP.STARTDATE = #{lastStartDate, jdbcType = DATE}
AND INFO.ASSET_TYPE IN ('04', '05', '14') AND INFO.ASSET_TYPE2 NOT IN ('2101', '1399', '1599', '2299')
AND FPT.TYPE_11 NOT IN ('057', '075', '076') AND (INFO.INDUSTRY1 IS NOT NULL OR INFO.INDUSTRY_SHARES IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY NVL(INFO.INDUSTRY1, INFO.INDUSTRY_SHARES) /*产业投资基金本季末余额*/ UNION ALL SELECT 'INDINCUR' AS reportType, INFO.INDUSTRY_SHARES AS propertyCode, NVL(SUM(NVL(CMAP.ASSETVALUE_A, 0)), 0) AS balance FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION CMAP LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO INFO ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = INFO.ASSET_CODE LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT ON FPT.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID WHERE CMAP.STARTDATE = #{startDate, jdbcType = DATE} AND INFO.INDUSTRY_SHARES IS NOT NULL AND FPT.TYPE_12 = '157' GROUP BY INFO.INDUSTRY_SHARES /*产业投资基金上季末余额*/ UNION ALL SELECT 'INDINLAST' AS reportType, INFO.INDUSTRY_SHARES AS propertyCode, NVL(SUM(NVL(CMAP.ASSETVALUE_A, 0)), 0) AS balance FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION CMAP LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO INFO ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = INFO.ASSET_CODE LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT ON FPT.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID WHERE CMAP.STARTDATE = #{lastStartDate, jdbcType = DATE} AND INFO.INDUSTRY_SHARES IS NOT NULL AND FPT.TYPE_12 = '157' GROUP BY INFO.INDUSTRY_SHARES /* 其他本季末数额 */ UNION ALL SELECT 'OTHERCUR' AS reportType, TEMP.INDUSTRY AS propertyCode, SUM(TEMP.ASSETVALUE_A) AS balance FROM OTHER_TABLE TEMP WHERE TEMP.STARTDATE = #{startDate, jdbcType = DATE} GROUP BY TEMP.INDUSTRY /* 其他上季末数额 */ UNION ALL SELECT 'OTHERLAST' AS reportType, TEMP.INDUSTRY AS propertyCode, SUM(TEMP.ASSETVALUE_A) AS balance FROM OTHER_TABLE TEMP WHERE TEMP.STARTDATE = #{lastStartDate, jdbcType = DATE} GROUP BY TEMP.INDUSTRY
